name: api-django
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: Backend with Django
description: Django with its admin, ORM and migrations, in its own virtual environment. For backends with a database and an admin panel from day one.

base.command: mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q django && .venv/bin/django-admin startproject config .

verify.command: .venv/bin/python manage.py check && .venv/bin/python manage.py test && (test ! -f pytest.ini || .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q)

instructions:
## How to work here

- Activate the environment with `source .venv/bin/activate`. Start with `python manage.py runserver`.
- Each domain is an app (`python manage.py startapp orders`) registered in `INSTALLED_APPS`.
- After changing models: `python manage.py makemigrations` and `migrate`. Never edit migrations that were already applied.
- After installing a package, update `requirements.txt`. Before finishing: `python manage.py check` and `python manage.py test`.
